## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when available.

## Validation

- [ ] `mise run check`
- [ ] `mise run check-repo`
- [ ] `mise run release` for application source or dependency changes
- [ ] Relevant regression coverage and documentation updated

For performance changes, link comparable release benchmarks and large-document
profiles with their limitations. For a Yrs patch change, include `mise run check-yrs`.
Describe any checks that could not run and remaining platform validation.
